Chapter 115: Chapter 8: The Fifth Star Cave (Subscribe Please)

Chapter 115: Chapter 8: The Fifth Star Cave (Subscribe Please)

Whoosh, whoosh, whoosh.

Many Evolvers entered the Transparent Passage in succession.

Lin Yuan, however, didn’t enter but planned to watch a bit longer.

After all, opportunities were rare, and it was unusual to witness so many Evolvers unleashing their full power at once.

Just then.

The nearly three meters tall, burly man walked up to the Transparent Passage.

His limbs were incredibly thick, and he carried a huge axe on his back, making him resemble a humanoid beast.

...

Boom, boom, boom!

With a stomp, the burly man unleashed a terrifying burst of power and charged towards the Transparent Passage.

“Terrifying.”

“Such immense strength, is he really of the Human Race?”

“Is he not one of those space beasts?”

The other Evolvers were startled and backed away.

Even the residual waves of power from the burly man could potentially injure an average Third Rank Evolver.

“Power.”

Lin Yuan’s gaze intensified.

He felt an endless amount of power emanating from the nearly three-meter-tall burly man.

[Your extraordinary insight has deepened your understanding of the Rule of Power]

…

“Rule of Power?”

Lin Yuan pondered.

Compared to the ubiquitous Space Rules, the Rule of Power seemed quite ordinary, but the burly man’s deep understanding of it might be why he was listed as one of the three Red Pattern Evolvers.

“I really want to get in close contact with these Evolvers…”

Lin Yuan longed, for to others, Red Pattern Evolvers were untouchable, to be looked up to.

But in Lin Yuan’s view, every Red Pattern Evolver was a treasure trove waiting to be discovered.

“There will be more opportunities in the future.”

“As long as I can successfully enter the Red Kun Lineage, why worry about the chance to meet them?”

Lin Yuan gathered his thoughts.

Soon.

The man with a red line on his forehead also passed through the Transparent Passage.

“Wind?”

Lin Yuan looked thoughtful.

He sensed the fluctuations of wind from the man with the red line on his forehead.

His speed through the passage was second only to the silver-haired woman, much faster than the nearly three-meter-tall burly man.

Several hours later.

Lin Yuan had watched enough, although other Evolvers continued to arrive from the First Star Cave.

But these Evolvers didn’t offer much help to Lin Yuan.

It was better than nothing.

Therefore, Lin Yuan didn’t want to waste time.

Just as Lin Yuan was about to get up.

Another Evolver appeared.

This Evolver was a young man.

And he gave Lin Yuan an inexplicable sense of familiarity.

“Fang Qing?”

Lin Yuan immediately recognized the other party.

The reason was that Lin Yuan often sparred with him.

To better understand the Ancient God Evolution Path, Lin Yuan had more than once deeply sensed the bodily changes in Fang Qing.

So even if Fang Qing changed his appearance or transformed his body shape.

Lin Yuan recognized him at a glance.

“Finally got through.”

Fang Qing arrived at the Second Star Cave and let out a slight sigh of relief.

The gravity challenge of the First Star Cave was quite difficult for him, and he only barely finished the last part of the track by resorting to an Ancient God Secret Technique.

“This Star Cave tests speed?”

Fang Qing also saw other Evolvers pass through the Transparent Passage and understood the nature of the test.

“Speed?”

“Ten seconds to reach the end of a forty-thousand-meter passage?”

Fang Qing’s expression changed slightly.

This was more than ten times the speed of sound, which might not be difficult for a Fourth Rank Evolver, but Fang Qing was currently only a Third Rank Evolver.

“No way.”

“I have to ask Teacher.”

Fang Qing disconnected from the Virtual World directly.

In the Seven Star Cave World, only the challengers could enter.

Others were barred from entry.

The white-bearded elder, being an artificial intelligence, belonged to an independent entity and naturally couldn’t enter.

If Fang Qing wanted to contact the white-bearded elder, he would have to exit the Seven Star Cave World first.

Seeing Fang Qing disappear, Lin Yuan immediately knew that he likely went to ‘call for help.’

“There shouldn’t be a big problem.”

Lin Yuan thought for a while.

He felt that Fang Qing should be able to pass through the Second Star Cave.

Compared to the First Star Cave, the test of the Second Star Cave might even be said to be simpler.

After all, to pass through the First Star Cave, one must persist through a hundred miles of track.

There might be tricks to tackle it, like using other methods or Secret Techniques to reduce the pressure of gravity.

But one still had to complete the hundred-mile track.

However, the challenge of the Second Star Cave was merely to reach the end forty thousand meters away within ten seconds.

This provided a lot of flexibility, and it gave room for many forbidden techniques to be deployed.

After all, with just ten seconds needed, even the most hazardous of forbidden techniques could be sustained without a problem.

Currently, everyone was in the Virtual World, and their bodies were simulations, so even if they paid a great price, they could recover very quickly.

Fang Qing just needed to choose a Secret Technique that exploited his potential. Even as a Third Rank Evolver, he had a chance to pass through the Second Star Cave.

…

After a moment of reflection, Lin Yuan took a step forward.

“It’s Lord Gold-Pattern.”

“We’ve seen Lord Gold-Pattern.”

“Please, Lord Gold-Pattern, you first.”

The other Evolvers waiting at the gate, immediately said respectfully.

For an average Silver Pattern Evolver, there wasn’t much difference between Red Patterns and Gold Patterns.

In any case, both were out of their league, and one needed to pay respects upon their sight.

Lin Yuan nodded slightly.

Took a step.

And entered the Transparent Passage.

Boom!!

Almost instantly.

Lin Yuan crossed thousands of meters.

In the forty-thousand-meter-long Transparent Passage, it took Lin Yuan less than seven seconds to reach the end.

Only after Lin Yuan reached the endpoint did the fearsome sound of the sonic boom arrive.

In front of the passage, dozens of Evolvers swallowed hard.

“This Lord Gold-Pattern, his speed is too fast.”

“Not bad, he seems faster than the other Gold-Pattern Lords.”
